interface.name: wkbmap_manager_unstable_v1
interface.description: Provides runtime configuration of the XKB keyboard layout associated with a Wayland seat.

request.name: get_keyboard
request.description: Create an object for configuring the keyboard associated with the specified Wayland seat.

interface.name: wkbmap_keyboard_unstable_v1
interface.description: Provides runtime configuration of the XKB layout associated with a Wayland keyboard seat.

entry.name: invalid_layout
entry.summary: the requested XKB layout is invalid

entry.name: failed
entry.summary: the compositor failed to apply the layout

request.name: set_layout
request.description:
Set the keyboard layout using the compositor's system XKB layout database.
The compositor is responsible for resolving the layout and applying the resulting XKB configuration to the seat.

event.name: layout
event.description: Announces the currently active XKB layout.
